description: Expanded lexical retrieval challenge fixture with paraphrases, competing memories, and hard negatives. This is a diagnostic dataset; failures expose lexical limits, not a release gate requiring perfect semantic recall.

memories.content: The workstation has an NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti graphics card with 16 GB of video memory.
The desktop processor is a Ryzen 7 9800X3D.
The workstation has approximately 32 GB of system RAM.
The local Qwen3.8-27B model runs through llama.cpp with CUDA acceleration.
The preferred local model configuration uses roughly 49K context with Q4_0 KV cache.
The local Qwen3.8-27B configuration produces approximately 40 tokens per second.
Every code-changing development pass must rebuild affected application artifacts and run relevant tests.
Development changes must use isolated feature branches or worktrees and preserve the running installation and uncommitted user changes.
Persistent memories must preserve provenance, confidence, timestamps, and supersession history.
Tentative memory candidates must remain outside trusted retrieval until the user approves them.
Semantic retrieval should find relevant memories when the user's wording differs substantially from the stored wording.
Interactive foreground inference should take priority over background workloads so the desktop remains responsive.

queries.query: Which graphics hardware is installed and how much video memory does it have?
What processor is in the desktop?
How much main system memory is available?
Which locally hosted language model and inference runtime are in use?
What context length and KV cache format are preferred?
How quickly does the local model generate output?
What must happen after source code is modified?
How should development avoid damaging the active app and local changes?
What historical metadata must remain attached to saved knowledge?
Can automatically extracted facts be used before a person confirms them?
How should recall behave when a question uses synonyms instead of the same keywords?
Which workload should win when GPU resources are constrained?
